Established in 1916, the bank provides retail, corporate, and treasury banking services, and operates branches across India.{{cite web |title=Karur Vysya Bank Ltd – Company Profile |url=https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/karur-vysya-bank-ltd/ |publisher=GlobalData |access-date=2025-12-31}} ==History== [[File:Karur Vysya Bank - Mysore Branch.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A Karur Vysya Bank branch in Mysore]] Karur Vysya Bank was founded on 25 July 1916 by M. A. Venkatarama Chettiar and Athi Krishna Chettiar to serve the banking requirements of traders and agricultural communities in and around Karur, Tamil Nadu.{{cite web |title=History of Karur Vysya Bank |url=https://www.kvb.co.in/about-us/history-kvb/ |publisher=Karur Vysya Bank |access-date=2025-12-31}} The institution gradually expanded beyond its regional base and developed into a pan-India banking network over the following decades.{{cite news |title=Karur Vysya’s long run |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/milestones/karur-vysyas-long-run |publisher=Business India |date=28 July 2020}} The bank's centenary celebrations were held in 2016 in Chennai, and were attended by the then President of India, [[Pranab Mukherjee]].{{cite web |title=Its Your Sacred Responsibility To Protect Money… – President’s Secretariat Press Release |url=https://presidentofindia.nic.in/shri-pranab-mukherjee/press_releases/its-your-sacred-responsibility-protect-money-those-who-have-reposed-trust-in-you-the-president-tells-bankers |publisher=President of India |date=10 September 2016}} ==Operations and network== As of February 2026, Karur Vysya Bank operated had 900 branches and 1,650 automated teller machines (ATMs) across multiple states in India.{{cite web |title=Branch Expansion Press Release |url=https://www.kvb.co.in/docs/press-release-kvb-expand-footprint-tn-karnataka.pdf |publisher=Karur Vysya Bank |access-date=20 May 2025}} The bank provides services in: * Retail and personal banking * Corporate and wholesale banking * Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) financing * Agricultural and rural banking * Treasury and foreign exchange services {{cite web|title=Karur Vysya Bank Ltd company profile|url=https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/karur-vysya-bank-ltd/|publisher=GlobalData|access-date=2025-12-31}} Its operations are regulated by the [[Reserve Bank of India]] and governed by statutory disclosures filed with Indian stock exchanges.{{cite web |title=Annual Report FY2024–25 |url=https://www.kvb.co.in/investor-corner/annual-reports |publisher=Karur Vysya Bank}} ==See also==
